title: ZO w/ Whitening
model: one-hidden-layer fixed-tanh-feature MLP with affine readout

audit.target_dependent_optimizer: CD-RGE two-sided random finite differences only
audit.gamma_selection: gamma is swept directly and selected by midpoint-grid validation after a fixed 1024-step budget; lambda=gamma*h is derived only for reporting
audit.test_role: evaluated only for the selected lambda after an independent final run
audit.full_whitening: one global target-independent SVD of the feature matrix
audit.partial_whitening: independent target-independent SVDs of contiguous feature blocks
